_comment: TAP-5303 ratchet. Enforced by scripts/check-container-budget.py in CI. 'ceiling' is what the gate enforces and moves only by a deliberate --update-baseline; 'target' is the TAP-5283 goal, not yet met. Refresh with: python scripts/check-container-budget.py --update-baseline (needs the stack up for the memory figure).

measured.how: production-profile services parsed from domains/*/compose.yml; memory is the resident total from docker stats across running non-agentforge containers
measured.memory_note: Service count re-measured 2026-08-23 when the six observability services (grafana, prometheus, alertmanager, postgres-exporter, jaeger, observability-dashboard) moved to a non-production 'observability' profile. Memory was NOT re-measured: those containers were still running, so docker stats would have reported the old total and recorded it as current. Re-run --update-baseline without --no-memory once the stack is up on the new profile set; the figure should fall by roughly 2.7 GB of image weight plus their resident share.
